note.en: BitoPro sign-up page (2026-10-28): over 18; no new registration for citizens of China, the U.S. and other places that may ban virtual currency.

label.en: BitoPro referral rewards (Super Referrer Reward Program, official)

title.zh-TW: 新戶通過 Level 2 驗證後 180 天 20% 交易手續費獎勵
title.en: 20% trading fee reward for 180 days after a new user passes Level 2 verification

text.zh-TW: 依官方推薦獎勵頁：適用尚未完成 Level 2 驗證的新戶；獎勵每日結算，累計達 10 USDT 才能領取。條件與期限以 BitoPro 官方公告為準。
text.en: Per the official referral page: new users not yet at Level 2; rewards settle daily and are claimable from 10 USDT. BitoPro's announcements prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（推薦人 ID 8238042506 已在連結中，會在新分頁開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (referrer ID 8238042506 is already in it; it opens in a new tab).

steps.zh-TW: 在註冊頁輸入電子郵件與密碼；「推薦人ID（選填）」欄位應已帶入 8238042506，若是空的請自行輸入。
steps.en: Enter your email and password on the sign-up page; the “Referrer ID (optional)” field should already show 8238042506, and if it is empty, type it in.

steps.zh-TW: 完成註冊後，依官方指示通過 Level 2 身分驗證；新戶的 180 天 20% 手續費獎勵從通過 Level 2 驗證起算。
steps.en: After registering, pass Level 2 identity verification as BitoPro instructs; the 180-day 20% fee reward for new users counts from passing Level 2.

intro.zh-TW: 幣託 BitoPro 加密貨幣交易所的邀請連結，推薦人 ID 已在連結中。依官方推薦獎勵頁，尚未完成 Level 2 驗證的新戶，通過驗證後 180 天內享交易手續費 20% 獎勵。
intro.en: Referral link for the BitoPro crypto exchange. Per its referral page, new users get a 20% fee reward for 180 days after passing Level 2 verification.

description.zh-TW:
BitoPro（幣託）是 BitoGroup 旗下的加密貨幣交易所。官網簡介自稱「台灣合規加密貨幣交易所」，支援 BTC、ETH、USDT 等主流幣種現貨交易，新臺幣可快速入金、用超商點數換幣，並提到冷錢包存放；這些是平台自述，本站沒有查證。官網頁尾載明：本公司已於 2025 年 9 月 22 日完成「提供虛擬資產服務之事業或人員洗錢防制登記」，核准文號為金管證券字第 1140350594 號；這同樣是業者頁面上的聲明，本站沒有向主管機關查證。

這個邀請連結已經帶有推薦人 ID 8238042506（網址中的 referrer 參數）。本站 2026-10-28 用瀏覽器開啟連結，註冊頁的「推薦人ID（選填）」欄位已自動填入這組數字；官方推薦獎勵頁把它稱為「推薦碼」。若欄位是空的，請自行填入。

依官方「超級推薦人獎勵計畫」頁（2026-10-28 讀取）：好友註冊享 20% 新戶交易獎勵——被推薦人如為尚未完成 Level 2 驗證的新戶，可於通過 Level 2 驗證起，享 180 天交易手續費 20% 獎勵；獎勵金額每日結算，累計達 10 USDT 即可領取，並以 USDT 匯率計算。推薦人方面，基礎方案可得被推薦人交易手續費的 20% 反佣；訂閱 2 層方案（月付 150 BITO）可再加 10%，單層方案為 30%。頁面主標寫「最高享 50% 獎勵金」，但同頁規則表最高只列 30%，頁面沒有說明差距，本站不採用 50% 這個數字。

活動自 2022/03/15 起，BitoPro 保留隨時調整、終止與最終解釋權；買賣帳號、虛假帳號等不正常操作不發獎勵並凍結帳號。BitoPro 註冊頁寫明年滿 18 歲，配合法規暫不支援中國、美國公民等可能禁止虛擬通貨的國家或地區新註冊及使用。實際內容與期限以 BitoPro 官方公告為準。
description.en:
BitoPro is a crypto exchange of BitoGroup. Its site description calls it a "compliant crypto exchange in Taiwan" that supports spot trading of major coins such as BTC, ETH and USDT, quick NT-dollar deposits and swapping convenience-store points for coins, and mentions cold-wallet storage; these are the platform's own statements and have not been checked by this site. The site footer states that the company completed the "anti-money-laundering registration for businesses or persons providing virtual asset services" on 2025-09-22, with approval number 金管證券字第1140350594號; this is also a statement on the operator's page and has not been checked with the regulator.

The referral link on this page already carries the referrer ID 8238042506 (the referrer parameter in the address). On 2026-10-28 this site opened the link in a browser, and the "Referrer ID (optional)" field (推薦人ID) on the sign-up page was filled in with this number; the official referral page calls it a "referral code" (推薦碼). If the field is empty, type it in yourself.

According to the official Super Referrer Reward Program page (read on 2026-10-28): friends get a 20% new-user trading reward. An invited user who has not yet completed Level 2 verification gets a 20% reward on trading fees for 180 days from passing Level 2 verification. Rewards are settled daily and can be claimed once they reach 10 USDT, calculated at USDT exchange rates. For the referrer, the basic plan earns a 20% rebate on the invited user's trading fees; the 2-layer subscription (150 BITO a month) adds 10%, and the single-layer plan pays 30%. The page headline says "up to 50% reward", but the rules table on the same page tops out at 30% and the page does not explain the gap, so this site does not use the 50% figure.

The program has run since 2022/03/15. BitoPro may adjust or end it at any time and keeps the final right of interpretation; trading in bought or fake accounts and other abnormal activity earns no rewards and gets the account frozen. The BitoPro sign-up page says you are over 18 and that, to comply with regulations, new registration and use are not supported for citizens of China, the U.S. and other places that may prohibit virtual currency. Actual terms and deadlines follow BitoPro's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 資料取自 BitoPro 的官方推薦獎勵頁、官網首頁與註冊頁（2026-10-28 讀取；註冊頁的欄位與自動帶入是用瀏覽器開啟連結確認的）。本站沒有實際註冊，不確定推薦人 ID 是否被計入，也沒有驗證獎勵的實際計算與領取。官網首頁的合規、冷錢包、資安評比與洗錢防制登記，都是業者頁面上的自述，本站沒有向主管機關或第三方查證。官方頁面的「最高享 50% 獎勵金」與規則表的 30% 不一致，本站不採用 50%。BitoPro 保留隨時調整、終止與最終解釋權。加密資產價格波動大，可能損失全部本金；請自行確認所在地區的法規與平台服務範圍。
notes.en: Data comes from BitoPro's official referral page, home page and sign-up page (read on 2026-10-28; the sign-up fields and the automatic fill were checked by opening the link in a browser). This site has not registered, so it is not known whether the referrer ID is credited, and it has not verified how rewards are calculated or claimed. The compliance, cold-wallet, security rating and anti-money-laundering registration statements on the home page are the operator's own and have not been checked with a regulator or a third party. The "up to 50% reward" headline on the official page does not match the 30% in the rules table, and this site does not use 50%. BitoPro may adjust or end the program at any time and keeps the final right of interpretation. Crypto assets are volatile and you can lose all your capital; check the law where you live and whether the platform serves your region.

q.zh-TW: BitoPro 邀請碼（推薦人 ID）要輸入在哪裡？
q.en: Where do I enter the BitoPro referral code (referrer ID)?

a.zh-TW: 註冊頁的欄位叫「推薦人ID（選填）」。用本頁的邀請連結開啟時，這個欄位已自動填入 8238042506（本站 2026-10-28 用瀏覽器確認）；若欄位是空的，請自行輸入 8238042506。
a.en: The field on the sign-up page is called "Referrer ID (optional)" (推薦人ID). When you open the referral link on this page it is already filled in with 8238042506 (checked in a browser on 2026-10-28); if it is empty, type 8238042506 yourself.

q.zh-TW: BitoPro 的推薦碼和推薦人 ID 是同一個東西嗎？
q.en: Are the BitoPro referral code and the referrer ID the same thing?

a.zh-TW: 本頁列出的 8238042506 同時是連結 referrer 參數與註冊欄位帶入的數字：官方推薦獎勵頁稱為「推薦碼」，註冊頁欄位叫「推薦人ID」。訂閱方案的推薦人可以另外自訂推薦碼，那是推薦人的功能，與新戶註冊無關。
a.en: The 8238042506 listed on this page is both the number in the link's referrer parameter and the number the sign-up field is filled with: the official referral page calls it a "referral code" (推薦碼) and the sign-up field is labeled "Referrer ID" (推薦人ID). Referrers on a subscription plan can set a custom referral code, which is a referrer feature and has nothing to do with a new user signing up.

q.zh-TW: 新戶的 20% 獎勵從什麼時候開始算？
q.en: When does the 20% new-user reward start?

a.zh-TW: 依官方推薦獎勵頁（2026-10-28 讀取）：被推薦人如為尚未完成 Level 2 驗證的新戶，從通過 Level 2 驗證起享 180 天交易手續費 20% 獎勵。獎勵金額每日結算，累計達 10 USDT 即可領取，並以 USDT 匯率計算。BitoPro 保留隨時調整、終止與最終解釋權。
a.en: Per the official referral page (read 2026-10-28): an invited user who has not yet completed Level 2 verification gets a 20% reward on trading fees for 180 days from passing Level 2 verification. Rewards settle daily, can be claimed once they reach 10 USDT and are calculated at USDT exchange rates. BitoPro may adjust or end the program at any time and keeps the final right of interpretation.

q.zh-TW: 官方頁面寫的「最高享 50% 獎勵金」是新戶能拿到的嗎？
q.en: Is the “up to 50% reward” on the official page what a new user gets?

a.zh-TW: 從頁面脈絡看不是：那是「超級推薦人獎勵計畫」的主標，講的是推薦人的分潤；而且同頁規則表最高只列 30%（基礎方案 20%、2 層訂閱方案最高 30%、單層訂閱方案 30%），頁面沒有說明 50% 從哪裡來。新戶的是通過 Level 2 驗證後 180 天的 20% 交易手續費獎勵。
a.en: From the page context, no: it is the headline of the Super Referrer Reward Program and describes the referrer's share. The rules table on the same page tops out at 30% (basic plan 20%, 2-layer subscription up to 30%, single-layer plan 30%) and the page does not say where 50% comes from. A new user gets the 20% trading fee reward for 180 days after passing Level 2 verification.
